entries.clue: "I wish we had beaten China in regulation time," sighed soccer's Mia Hamm ____
"Tarzan is a huge hit!" exclaimed Disney's Michael Eisner ____
"Cooking is my passion," shouted Julia Child ____
"I don't like criticism of our military," argued Secretary William Cohen ____
"I'll raise interest rates if necessary," murmured Alan Greenspan ____
"I'm always looking to buy companies," offered tycoon Warren Buffett ____
She made her Met debut in 1893
"I do many operations without charge," smiled Dr. Michael De Bakey ____
"The von Bulow case really made me a star," opined Alan Dershowitz ____
"My career's gone nowhere since the Holyfield fight," grumbled Mike Tyson ___
What there's nothin' like, in song
"Our troops will keep peace in the Balkans," offered NATO's Wesley Clark ____
"I can't talk to you right now," snapped Cindy Crawford ____
Candy named from the German for "peppermint"
